method: independent second check; every stage of l1-l6 read in full (items, pinyin and tone sandhi, sentences and token splits, explain, gq, panel, teach); no numeric items in language packs; encyclopedia titles verified

corrections.what: claimed older siblings have 'heavy' sounds and younger 'light' ones, which is false (gēge/dìdi); replaced with an accurate memory aid
said a cup takes 杯 as a measure word like 个; 杯 is for cupfuls of drink, clarified
example 我昨天吃。 is an incomplete sentence; changed to 我昨天吃米饭。
described 离 as 'to compare places'; it expresses distance between two places
'一 changes before other tones: yí gè' was misleading; now states yí before fourth tone and yì before tones 1-3
grammar slip 'used on the media' corrected to 'in the media'
弟弟 is a younger brother; English 'my brother' made 'my younger brother'
generalisation 'classical poetry uses very short lines' softened
'tone of voice' in the revision checklist changed to register
細胞 (cell) is a Japanese coinage, 基因 a Chinese coinage; wording corrected; 'units come with numbers' reworded accurately
unclear question about 经济 rewritten (where the modern sense comes from) and why made accurate

4 non-existent titles replaced: Public transport in China -> Rail transport in China; Business Chinese -> Standard Chinese; Chinese business culture -> Guanxi; Interpretation (translation) -> Language interpretation

wrong options rewritten as plausible learner errors so the key is no longer the single longest option; stat went from 120 of 270 (44%) to 32 of 270 (12%). Items: l1 s2-s9, l2 s1-s9, l3 s1-s9, l4 s1-s9, l5 s1-s9, l6 s1-s9 (indices in patch history); keys unchanged
